topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking into the school, the familiar corridors seem longer, the walls more oppressive. The last time I was here, I was just another student, and Mrs. Carson was the towering figure in the classroom. As I stand outside my child’s classroom, a flood of memories rushes back, each one more vivid than the last. I remember the stern glances, the homework that seemed impossible, and the way she always seemed to know when I was struggling. Now, here I am, and my child is about to step into that same world. I can feel my heart pounding as I watch Mrs. Carson greeting students with a warmth I don’t recall from my time. How will she treat my child? Will the past repeat itself?
